g.text: Separate experiment: 200 unique synthetic pairs · eight designed report patterns · 25 pairs per pattern (20 original + 5 additional)

g.text: Zero tested-digit exposure alone does not imply success: the institution-developed pipeline preserved no complete molecular expressions.

g.text: Refinement produced 50 additional successful pairs out of 200, across two report patterns (p = 0.50 accounting for patterns).
